# 消耗随其供给者终结：在平衡、只有活跃者给予、活动需要支持之下，没有被支持者向一个条件给予时，从它取用的形成至多连续活跃该条件水平那么多步；供给者都不被支持时就是这样；一个在所需条件上保住自身支持的形成，仍可经其供给者终结 / Consumption ends with its feeders: under balance, with only active formations giving and activity needing support, where nothing supported gives to a condition, a formation taking from it is active for at most as many consecutive steps as its level; so it is where every feeder is unsupported; a formation that keeps its own support over the condition it requires can still end through its feeder

## 主张 Claim

设流平衡（Flow.Balances），只有活跃者给予（Flow.Acting），活动需要支持（Web.Dependent）。若形成 g 从第 T 步起在其活跃的每一步都在场并从条件 c 取用，而在这些步没有被支持者向 c 给予，则 g 从第 T 步起至多连续活跃 c 在第 T 步的水平那么多步（Flow.Balances.unfed_consumption_ends，由 Flow.excess_bounded 推出），所以并非从第 T 步起每步都活跃（Flow.Balances.unfed_consumption_stops）。若 g 活跃时需要 c，而从第 T 步起供给其延续的都不被支持，则没有被支持者向 c 给予（Flow.unfed_of_feeders_unsupported），所以同一界成立（Flow.Balances.consumption_ends_with_feeders）。见证 Overshoot：两个形成各自以所需一依存于以自身命名的条件，两个条件起初都立于一；第 0 步 true 从两个条件各取一个单位并向 false 的条件给予一个，false 从自己的条件取一个并向 true 的条件给予一个，所以任一个的供给闭包都是整体（Overshoot.closure_whole）。流平衡，只有活跃者给予，只有活跃者取用、且只从其所汲取者取用，活动需要支持；第 0 步 true 在其所需的唯一条件上更新（Web.RenewingOver），在第 1 步仍被支持，而它的汲取侵蚀 false 的依存（Web.UnderminingAt），false 在第 0 步供给 true 的条件；false 从第 1 步起不被支持，true 从第 1 步起至多连续活跃一步，从第 2 步起没有任何被支持者（Overshoot.ends_through_feeder）。依存相同而各自只从自己的条件取用时（Overshoot.steadyFlow、Overshoot.steadyWeb），流平衡，两者每步都活跃且被支持（Overshoot.steady_continues）。不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。 / Let the flow balance (Flow.Balances), with only active formations giving (Flow.Acting) and activity needing support (Web.Dependent). If a formation g is present and takes from a condition c at every step from T at which it is active, while nothing supported gives to c at those steps, then g is active for at most as many consecutive steps from T as the level of c at T (Flow.Balances.unfed_consumption_ends, derived from Flow.excess_bounded), so it is not active at every step from T (Flow.Balances.unfed_consumption_stops). If g requires c while active and everything feeding its continuation from T on is unsupported, nothing supported gives to c (Flow.unfed_of_feeders_unsupported), so the same bound holds (Flow.Balances.consumption_ends_with_feeders). The witness Overshoot: each of two formations depends at need one on the condition named by it, both conditions standing at one at the start; at step 0 true takes one unit from each condition and gives one to false's, and false takes one from its own and gives one to true's, so the feeding closure of either is the whole (Overshoot.closure_whole). The flow balances, only active formations give, only active formations take and only from what they draw on, and activity needs support; at step 0 true renews over the one condition it requires (Web.RenewingOver) and is still supported at step 1, while its draw undermines false's dependence (Web.UnderminingAt), and false feeds true's condition at step 0; false is unsupported from step 1 on, true is active for at most one consecutive step from step 1, and from step 2 on nothing is supported (Overshoot.ends_through_feeder). With the same dependences, each taking only from its own condition (Overshoot.steadyFlow, Overshoot.steadyWeb), the flow balances and both are active and supported at every step (Overshoot.steady_continues). No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence
